Faculty Vacancy
Saturday, 17 May 2025
2933 Hits
Applications in the prescribed proforma (
Available Here
) with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification are invited for the below mentioned posts.
Assistant Professor in the department of Biochemistry, Physiology & Surgery.
Senior Residents and Tutors in the department of Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Microbiology, Forensic Medicine & Pharmacology.
Qualification / Experience:-
Assistant Professor-
MBBS with NMC recognized Post-graduate Degree and one year experience as Senior Resident in concerned subject.
Senior Residents-
MD/ MS/ DNB in above mentioned subjects as per NMC & MUHS norms.
Tutors:
MBBS or M.Sc. in Medical Anatomy / Physiology / Biochemistry from a recognized University / Institute.
Salary:
As per Kasturba Health Society’s Rules
Age Limit
: upto 45 years of age.
Note:
1. Application to be submitted to Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Po. Sevagram, Wardha 442102 for the post of Assistant Professor & to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences for the post of SeniorResident & Tutor,
latest by 30/5/2025.
2. Only eligible candidates will be called for document verification / Interview
3. Decision of Selection Committee will be final and binding.
4. Competent appointing authority reserves right to reject any or all applications.
DEAN
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
